description_or_sql: Groups of customers that buy together, such as franchise chains.
Customer types, for example Novelty Shop or Supermarket.
Customers, one row per customer account. A customer may be billed to another account.
Days the customer has to pay an invoice.
Customer ledger: invoices (positive amounts) and payments received (negative amounts).
Invoices, one per order shipped. A credit note is an invoice with is_credit_note true.
Profit on the line, before tax.
Customer orders. An order is invoiced once its goods are picked.
Employees and customer or supplier contacts.
Lines of a purchase order, counted in outers (supplier packs).
Promotions - a discount or special price for a stock item or stock group, for a customer, buying group or customer category, between two dates.
States and provinces, each with a sales territory.
Sales territory the state belongs to, for example Southeast.
Product groups, for example Novelty Items or Clothing. A stock item can be in several groups.
Standard selling price per unit, before tax.
Current stock on hand per stock item.
Which stock groups each stock item belongs to (many to many).
Stock movements: receipts are positive, issues to customers negative, stocktake adjustments either sign.
Supplier ledger - supplier invoices, payments and credit notes.
Kinds of financial and stock transactions, for example Customer Invoice or Stock Receipt.
SELECT 100 * SUM(il.lineprofit) / SUM(il.extendedprice - il.taxamount) FROM sales.invoicelines il
SELECT SUM(il.extendedprice - il.taxamount) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoiceid) FROM sales.invoicelines il JOIN sales.invoices i ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
